faq.q: What CAD/Vector file formats do you accept for custom orders?
faq.a: We accept DXF, SVG, AI (Adobe Illustrator), CDR (CorelDRAW), PDF (Vector), and DWG. Our pre-press engineering team automatically verifies your files for closed vectors and kerf compensation before cutting.

faq.q: Can I order custom thicknesses or specific sheet dimensions?
faq.a: Yes! Use our 3D Customizer Studio to input any width and height up to 2400 x 1200 mm. We stock MDF in 2mm, 3.2mm, 5.5mm, 8mm, 12mm, and 18mm, and Acrylic in 2mm, 3mm, 4.5mm, 6mm, 8mm, 10mm, and 15mm.

faq.q: How do you calculate bulk order discounts?
faq.a: Our automated tier pricing offers 10% off for 11-50 units, 20% off for 51-200 units, and factory direct contract rates for 200+ units. You can also request a customized quotation via the Bulk Enquiries modal or WhatsApp.

faq.q: How does ordering via WhatsApp work?
faq.a: Click any 'Order via WhatsApp' button. Our app automatically compiles your exact specifications (product, material, custom thickness, dimensions, finish, quantity, and reference link) into a clean, ready-to-send WhatsApp chat with our engineering desk.
